requirements: R1: Extend the architecture runtime contract (docs/architecture/adr-002-runtime-contract.md) to explicitly define the single datastore technology.
R2: Update application.properties, docker-compose.yml, and related artifacts to derive their datastore stack strictly from the ADR contract without duplication.

slices.title: Align application configurations with ADR datastore contract
slices.jtbd: When implementing the datastore alignment for this epic, I want to update the ADR and configuration files, so that all environments run against a consistent database stack.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository configurations,
When validating the datastore settings,
Then the ADR must name the datastore technology, and both application.properties and docker-compose.yml must be configured to use it with successful test execution.

requirements: R1: Replace the H2-specific CREATE ALIAS syntax in the Flyway migration with valid PostgreSQL syntax.

slices.title: Resolve PostgreSQL Flyway migration syntax error
slices.jtbd: When implementing the database schema fix for this epic, I want to update the migration scripts to use PostgreSQL-compatible syntax, so that application startup and health checks succeed.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a PostgreSQL datastore,
When the application runs the database migrations during startup,
Then the migration must execute successfully without syntax errors, and the runtime health check must pass.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce application startup failure rate from 100% to 0%.
